'''Curse''' is a [[special]] card that [[investigator]]s take when they become ''Cursed''.  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Upkeep''': Roll a die and discard this card on a 1.

'''Any Phase''': When rolling dice, you only score successes on a 6.  If you are [[Blessing|Blessed]], discard this card instead of gaining a Blessing card.

[[Category:Specials]]
[[Category:Statuses]]

==Ways to Become Cursed==
* Different [[encounter]]s in [[Arkham]] or [[Other World]]s will cause an investigator to become cursed. 
*[[Rex Murphy]] will start the game with a curse.
*[[Ursula Downs]] failing her personal story.
*[[Bob Jenkins]] failing his personal story.
*[[Yig]] will curse all investigators upon [[Ancient One Awakens|Awakening]]
